example.title: George Spangerberger Farmstead, Pole Building (HABS KS-77-H)

brief: Open-fronted pole shed of about 1960, roughly 40 ft long and 16 ft deep: a single-slope corrugated metal roof on round wooden poles with short knee braces to a plank header, the back and ends closed with horizontal wooden planks, the front wide open to a dirt yard. Used for parking the tractor, disc and hog feeders out of the weather; a board-fenced lot runs off one end and a corrugated-tin building and big shade trees crowd the other.
